description: Source code for the TunDevicePacketExchanger class, handling packet transmission and reception over TUN/TAP devices with IPv6 and neighbor solicitation handling.

classes.name: TunDevicePacketExchanger
classes.description: Handles packet exchange over TUN/TAP devices, including L2 header application and consumption, and neighbor solicitation responses.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Writes a packet to the TUN device, applying L2 headers if necessary.

methods.name: ReadPacket
methods.description: Reads a packet from the TUN device, processing L2 headers and handling neighbor solicitations.

methods.name: set_file_descriptor
methods.description: Sets the file descriptor for the TUN device.

methods.name: stats_interface
methods.description: Returns the stats interface associated with this exchanger.

methods.name: ApplyL2Headers
methods.description: Adds L2 headers to an IPv6 packet for transmission.

methods.name: ConsumeL2Headers
methods.description: Removes L2 headers from a packet and handles neighbor solicitation responses.
